privacyLead: How this website works and what happens when you contact Autolejek.
privacyContactText: Contact: autolejek@gmail.com. Correspondence is handled through Gmail. Your email address, message and any attachments are used to read and respond to your enquiry. Messages are stored in the Gmail mailbox. Google, as the provider of Gmail, also processes data as described in its privacy policy linked below. Send only information needed to discuss your enquiry; avoid unnecessary personal details in photos and documents.
privacyHostingText: This website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub records and stores visitor IP addresses for security purposes, including visits by people who are not signed in to GitHub. Details are available in GitHub’s documentation and privacy statement.
privacyStorageText: The website saves your choice of light or dark theme in your browser’s local storage under autolejek-theme. This value is read on later visits to restore your choice. You can remove it by clearing this website’s browser data. The website code does not include analytics, advertising trackers, account registration or a contact form.
privacyLinksText: Links to YouTube, product suppliers and other websites take you to services with their own privacy policies. The YouTube channel is linked rather than embedded in this website.
privacyRequestsText: For questions about information you have sent to Autolejek, contact autolejek@gmail.com. Depending on the circumstances and applicable law, you may have rights to access, correct or erase your data, restrict processing, object to processing or receive your data in a portable format. You may also complain to a data protection authority; in Poland this is the President of UODO.
privacyContactLink: Read the privacy information before sending an enquiry.
